$description: Stack (platform/components/Stack, library wave 3, extend): the tokens of Center and Bleed. The gaps and insets of Stack and Inline are in components.tokens.json.

center-sm-max-width.$description: Center: the maximum width sm (a sign-in form, an empty state).

center-md-max-width.$description: Center: the maximum width md (the default: a page of one form or one message).

center-lg-max-width.$description: Center: the maximum width lg (reading width for a page of text).

center-page-max-width.$description: Center: the maximum width page (the contained layout's maximum width).

bleed-xs-margin-inline.$description: Bleed: the start and end margin that cancels a Stack's xs inset (its inline padding, negated).

bleed-xs-margin-block.$description: Bleed: the top and bottom margin that cancels a Stack's xs inset (its block padding, negated).

bleed-sm-margin-inline.$description: Bleed: the start and end margin that cancels a Stack's sm inset (its inline padding, negated).

bleed-sm-margin-block.$description: Bleed: the top and bottom margin that cancels a Stack's sm inset (its block padding, negated).

bleed-md-margin-inline.$description: Bleed: the start and end margin that cancels a Stack's md inset (its inline padding, negated).

bleed-md-margin-block.$description: Bleed: the top and bottom margin that cancels a Stack's md inset (its block padding, negated).

bleed-lg-margin-inline.$description: Bleed: the start and end margin that cancels a Stack's lg inset (its inline padding, negated).

bleed-lg-margin-block.$description: Bleed: the top and bottom margin that cancels a Stack's lg inset (its block padding, negated).

bleed-xl-margin-inline.$description: Bleed: the start and end margin that cancels a Stack's xl inset (its inline padding, negated).

bleed-xl-margin-block.$description: Bleed: the top and bottom margin that cancels a Stack's xl inset (its block padding, negated).
